error[VIBE2301]: `@click` needs a handler.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:2:6
2 |   <p @click></p>
  |      ^^^^^^
fix: Write the handler, as in `@click="save"`.
fix: Remove `@click`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2301

error[VIBE2302]: `v-on` needs an event name and cannot take an object of listeners.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:3:6
3 |   <p v-on="fixed"></p>
  |      ^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Write one `@event="handler"` attribute per event.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2302

error[VIBE2303]: The event name of `v-on` must be static.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:4:7
4 |   <p @[text]="count++"></p>
  |       ^^^^^^
fix: Write a static event name and decide inside the handler what to do.
fix: Attach the listener with `addEventListener` from a template ref.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2303

error[VIBE2304]: `.foo` is not an event modifier.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:5:13
5 |   <p @click.foo="count++"></p>
  |             ^^^
fix: Fix the spelling of `.foo`.
fix: Check the key inside the handler.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2304

error[VIBE2305]: `.stop` cannot modify a component event.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:6:15
6 |   <Item @pick.stop="count++" />
  |               ^^^^
fix: Remove `.stop` and handle the case inside the handler.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2305

error[VIBE2401]: `:foo-bar` needs a value.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:7:6
7 |   <p :foo-bar></p>
  |      ^^^^^^^^
fix: Write the value, as in `:foo-bar="value"`.
fix: Remove the binding.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2401

error[VIBE2402]: `.foo` is not a `v-bind` modifier.
  --> template/event-binding-errors/input.vibe:8:13
8 |   <p :title.foo="text"></p>
  |             ^^^
fix: Remove `.foo`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2402
